title: Les Mills NZ Class Guide – Choose the Right Les Mills Class
meta_desc: Find out which Les Mills class—BodyPump, BodyCombat, BodyBalance, RPM, SH'BAM or GRIT—fits your goals, calorie burn and NZ gym options.
intro: Les Mills classes dominate group‑fitness in New Zealand. Whether you want to lift, punch, flow or sweat, each programme has a clear purpose and a typical calorie burn. This guide breaks down the six flagship classes and tells you which NZ gyms deliver the best experience.

sections.heading: BodyPump – Barbell Strength for Everyone
sections.body: BodyPump is a 55‑minute choreographed weight‑lifting class set to high‑energy music. You use a barbell and adjustable plates to work all major muscle groups. Beginners start with lighter weights and focus on form, while seasoned lifters can increase load for hypertrophy. The class burns roughly 350‑500 kcal per session, depending on effort and weight used. Many NZ chains—City Fitness, Anytime Fitness and Jetts—run multiple BodyPump sessions each week, often with certified Les Mills instructors.
list: Best for: building muscular endurance and basic strength
NZ gym hotspots: City Fitness (large class capacity), Anytime Fitness (24‑hour access for extra practice)

sections.heading: BodyCombat – Cardio Martial Arts
sections.body: BodyCombat delivers a high‑intensity cardio workout using moves from karate, boxing, taekwondo and muay thai. No experience is required; the choreography teaches you proper technique as you go. Expect a 45‑minute session that can torch 400‑600 kcal. The class improves coordination, cardiovascular fitness and stress relief. Look for BodyCombat at Les Mills‑affiliated studios, City Fitness and Anytime Fitness, where the vibe is often more energetic than a traditional spin class.
list: Best for: cardio lovers who enjoy a punch‑and‑kick routine
NZ gym hotspots: Les Mills studios (authentic brand experience), City Fitness (wide class timetable)

sections.heading: BodyBalance – Mind‑Body Fusion
sections.body: BodyBalance blends yoga, Pilates and Tai Chi into a 45‑minute low‑impact session. It focuses on flexibility, core stability and mindful breathing, making it ideal for recovery days or beginners who feel intimidated by high‑intensity classes. Calorie burn is modest—around 200‑300 kcal—but the benefits to posture and stress management are significant. Most major NZ chains, including Anytime Fitness, Jetts and City Fitness, schedule BodyBalance in the mornings and evenings to suit working adults.
list: Best for: improving mobility, core strength and mental focus
NZ gym hotspots: Anytime Fitness (flexible class times), Jetts (small class sizes)

sections.heading: RPM – Indoor Cycling Power Session
sections.body: RPM is a 45‑minute indoor cycling class that simulates hill climbs, sprints and endurance rides. Riders adjust resistance to match the music‑driven choreography, making it a calorie‑tornado—typically 500‑700 kcal per class. It’s perfect for cyclists, runners and anyone looking to boost leg power without joint impact. RPM is a staple at City Fitness, Les Mills studios and Anytime Fitness, with many locations offering early‑morning and post‑work slots for commuters.
list: Best for: leg strength, cardiovascular endurance and low‑impact cardio
NZ gym hotspots: City Fitness (large spin studios), Les Mills (brand‑specific bikes)

sections.heading: SH'BAM & GRIT – Dance Cardio & HIIT Power
sections.body: SH'BAM fuses popular music with dance moves for a fun, 45‑minute cardio party, burning roughly 350‑450 kcal. It’s ideal for those who want a social workout and don’t mind looking a bit goofy. GRIT, on the other hand, is a 30‑minute high‑intensity interval training (HIIT) session that alternates short bursts of maximal effort with brief recovery, torching 400‑600 kcal in a compact timeframe. Both classes suit different moods: SH'BAM for a lively cardio session, GRIT for a quick, sweat‑dripping strength boost. City Fitness, Anytime Fitness and Jetts all run SH'BAM weekly, while GRIT is often offered at Les Mills‑affiliated studios and larger City Fitness locations.
list: SH'BAM – 45 min, 350‑450 kcal, great for beginners and dance lovers
GRIT – 30 min, 400‑600 kcal, best for time‑pressed athletes seeking HIIT
NZ gym hotspots: City Fitness (both classes), Anytime Fitness (SH'BAM evenings), Les Mills (GRIT specialist)
